theorems.name: Submission.dorag_standing_density_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∃ δ₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ δ₁ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ ρ : ℝ) (z : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ W → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → z ∈ R.measure.support → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → κ * ρ ≤ δ → (∀ y ∈ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → R.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ 2 * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) ≤ 2 * R.measure (closedBall y t)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ (1 - 4 * δ) * ρ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y t, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₂ * δ)) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall z (4 * δ * ρ) → R.mult x = 1)
